Shehzad Poonawalla Resigns From BJP Again

Shehzad Poonawalla has resigned from the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) for a second time. He stated that he was leaving the party he loves due to "pressing" financial and personal issues. Poonawalla, a visible spokesperson for the BJP on television debates, indicated he might join the private sector. His initial resignation letter was reportedly rejected by the party.
